{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Oro Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] used by the [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]].

The squadron was used to try to [[Battle of Kiilimaar|kidnap]] the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief scientist]] when the Imperials defeated the [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]]. The attempt was unsuccessful and the T-wings, along with [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Boegis Squadron]] were destroyed and the transport ''[[Choora]]'' was captured.
